## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved hydration of server-rendered pages so statically bound attributes are applied or updated to match client values.
  * Corrected handling of attributes and text supplied through spread bindings, avoiding unnecessary changes to server-rendered content.
  * Fixed hydration of HTML and text content, including cases where empty client content should clear server-rendered content.
  * Preserved unchanged resource URLs and input value-related attributes during hydration.
